root_cause_confirmed.what_v1_got_wrong: v1's hexagon predicate applied word-level theta/tau substitution UNCONDITIONALLY to every window, without checking whether c (the PB3 full twist, (s1 s2 s1)^2) lies in K. Word-level substitution is only well-defined as a function of the GROUP ELEMENT (not the specific word representing it) when c is in K; when c is not in K, tau does not descend to F2/K_F2, and the same group element can give different (3.11) verdicts depending on which word represents it.
root_cause_confirmed.concrete_impact_measured_this_pass: Of the 5 small calibration windows already tested in v1, F6 (c in K) was computed for real in this repair and found FALSE for 3 of them (b3_index 96, 12, 48) and TRUE for only 2 (b3_index 18, 3). This means v1's verdicts for the 3 c_notin_K windows were computed via a predicate that is NOT a well-defined function of the shadow's group-theoretic coordinates -- exactly the falsifier's finding, now independently reproduced and localized by this repair.
root_cause_confirmed.not_an_implementer_error: Per the coordinator's own message, this is a repair of a spec v1 defect (its SS2.3 word-level prescription), not an implementer bug in the original v1 code, which correctly implemented what v1's (now-dead) spec asked for.
